items.title: Josh Jacobs: Could be back for Week 12
items.text:
Jacobs (finger) has a "realistic chance" of returning to action Nov. 25 against the Rams following the Packers' Week 11 bye, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Baker Mayfield: May be trending toward sitting Week 11
items.text:
The Buccaneers appear to be preparing for the possibility of Mayfield (foot) being sidelined for Sunday's game against the Lions, after the team signed Cooper Rush to the practice squad and signed Easton Stick to the 53-man roster Monday, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tre' Harris: Career-best yardage total in win
items.text:
Harris secured all five targets for 86 yards in the Chargers' 23-20 win over the Ravens on Monday night.

items.title: Mark Andrews: Season-best effort in Brissett's debut
items.text:
Andrews brought in all eight targets for 82 yards in the Ravens' 23-20 loss to the Chargers on Monday.

items.title: Justin Herbert: Efficient in first win of season
items.text:
Herbert completed 12 of 18 passes for 129 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions and rushed seven times for 51 yards and a touchdown in the Chargers' 23-20 win over the Ravens on Monday night.
